rows.commentary: 4.6: Randell drifts it across the left-handed Yashasvi Jaiswal, who watches it sail past with arms comfortably shouldered.
5.1: Zak Gibson draws a thick inside edge off Sai Sudharsan's cover drive, allowing the pair to scamper a sharp single wide of mid-on.
5.2: Zak Gibson targets the stumps with a swinging full delivery, comfortably defended straight back to the bowler by Yashasvi Jaiswal.
5.3: Zak Gibson slants one away from Yashasvi Jaiswal, who decides to leave it entirely for the waiting glovework of the keeper.
5.4: Yashasvi Jaiswal clips Zak Gibson into the deep square leg where the heavy grass slows the ball near the ropes, permitting three well-run runs.
5.5: Zak Gibson tempts Sai Sudharsan with a full length on middle and leg, inducing a closed-face leading edge that lobs softly back down the track.
5.6: Zak Gibson strays down the leg-side, offering Sai Sudharsan an easy clip around the corner toward fine leg for a single.
6.1: Randell charges in from round the wicket, hitting a heavy length that squares up Sai Sudharsan on the defensive push.
6.2: Randell extracts alarming extra bounce from a back-of-a-length delivery, sailing over Sai Sudharsan's shoulder as he wisely stands his ground.
6.3: Randell probes the channel outside off stump, leaving Sai Sudharsan to cover his wicket and offer a precise leave.
6.4: Randell attacks with a very full delivery outside off, jammed out sharply to mid-on by Sai Sudharsan.
6.5: Sai Sudharsan steps down to smother Randell's short-of-length ball, using his right leg to halt a trickling deflection that threatened to roll back onto his stumps.
6.6: Randell digs it into the pads, and Sai Sudharsan clips it away neatly into the on-side for a single.
7.1: Zak Gibson angles one across the southpaw, watching it nestle safely into the glove of the keeper.
7.2: Zak Gibson serves a full, swinging delivery, met by a forward press and a soft push to the left of the bowler.
7.3: Zak Gibson slides it across the line, leaving Sai Sudharsan to cover up and steer it toward point.
7.4: Zak Gibson probes at the hips with a shorter length, tying Sai Sudharsan up in an awkward tangle.
7.5: Zak Gibson persists on a back-of-a-length trajectory, safely negotiated by a compact defensive block off the back foot.
7.6: Zak Gibson offers a half-volley outside off, and Sai Sudharsan drives crisply through the covers to hustle back for three runs.
8.1: Randell comes round the wicket with extra bounce, allowing Sai Sudharsan to drop it softly in front of point.
8.2: Randell floats a full one near the off stump, gently defended by a forward stride from Sai Sudharsan.
8.3: Randell gets one to jag sharply off the seam, catching the inside edge of Sai Sudharsan's back-foot prod as it scuttles down to fine leg for a single.
18.1: Ferns drills in a searing yorker, forcing Yashasvi Jaiswal to frantically jam it out.
18.2: Ferns angles one sharply across the left-hander, the umpire nearly stretching his arms for a wide.
18.3: Yashasvi Jaiswal chases a booming drive at a full delivery that swerves away, comprehensively beating the outside edge.
18.4: Ferns fires it full and wide of Yashasvi Jaiswal, who calmly steers the defensive stroke into the off-side.
18.5: Yashasvi Jaiswal watches the length delivery drift safely past outside off stump and ignores it.
18.6: Danru Ferns crashes to the turf after delivery while Yashasvi Jaiswal watches the ball sail through to the keeper.
19.1: Jarrod McKay skids one low into the middle stump, demanding an athletic low block from Sai Sudharsan.
19.2: Jarrod McKay darts the ball into the left-hander, prompting Sai Sudharsan to tuck it neatly toward mid-wicket.
19.3: Sai Sudharsan clips the pad-bound delivery straight towards the fielder stationed at short leg.
19.4: Jarrod McKay serves up a full length on middle, and Sai Sudharsan pushes it solidly down to mid-on.
19.5: A sharp back-of-a-length delivery on middle squares up Sai Sudharsan as he attempts a hurried back-foot defense.
19.6: Sai Sudharsan defends the final ball back to Jarrod McKay, sealing a hard-earned maiden over.
20.1: Ferns steams in with a back-of-a-length delivery angling far down the leg-side, leaving the gloveman to scramble sharply across and smother the ball.
20.2: Ferns extracts away-movement from the surface against the southpaw, prompting Jaiswal to cushion it softly toward point.
20.3: Ferns targets a probing angle across the left-hander as Jaiswal smartly judges the trajectory and withdraws his bat entirely.
20.4: Ferns lands a good-length delivery around the off-stump, met confidently by Jaiswal on the front foot.
20.5: Ferns drifts onto the pads, allowing Yashasvi Jaiswal to whip it toward mid-on where a desperate diving stop restricts them to a single.
20.6: Danru Ferns finds a searing away-movement that flashes past Sai Sudharsan's outside edge as the batter plays inside the line.
24.2: Zak Gibson targets the channel outside off, and Yashasvi Jaiswal wisely watches it pass before an inside edge trickles the ball toward midwicket.
24.3: Zak Gibson delivers into the pads, and Yashasvi Jaiswal clips it into the leg side to sprint through for a sharp single.
24.4: Zak Gibson comes from round the wicket, pinning Sai Sudharsan on the ribs as the batsman's bottom hand flies off the handle during a painful tuck.
24.5: Zak Gibson drifts one across the left-hander, drawing a gentle tap to point from Sai Sudharsan.
24.6: Zak Gibson drops it short down the leg-side, and Sai Sudharsan masterfully swivels to roll his wrists and pull the ball racing away to the boundary.
25.1: Cameron Paul digs it in short on middle stump, watching Yashasvi Jaiswal duck safely beneath the trajectory.
25.2: Cameron Paul drifts a wide delivery far outside off that Yashasvi Jaiswal ignores, only for the umpire's arm to signal a no-ball for over-stepping.
25.2: Cameron Paul angles it across the left-hander once more, and Yashasvi Jaiswal offers no shot.
25.3: Cameron Paul swings a full delivery into the left-hander, trapping Yashasvi Jaiswal on the right boot as he loses balance, though he quickly recovers from the blow.
25.4: Cameron Paul dangles width outside off, tempting Yashasvi Jaiswal into a mistimed cut stroke.
25.5: Cameron Paul sends down another inswinging full delivery on the pads, turning away with a thick inside edge off Yashasvi Jaiswal's flick toward deep mid-wicket.
25.6: Cameron Paul pitches it right up on the pads, allowing Sai Sudharsan to flick it away down to fine leg for a pair of runs.
26.1: Zak Gibson drops it short outside the channel, and Yashasvi Jaiswal hops across the crease to dead-bat it straight into the bowler's territory.
26.2: Zak Gibson angles a length delivery across the left-hander, and Yashasvi Jaiswal watches it sail through untouched.
26.3: Zak Gibson feeds a length ball straight to backward point, prompting Yashasvi Jaiswal to eye a quick single before Sai forcefully halts the charge.
26.4: Zak Gibson offers width outside off, allowing Yashasvi Jaiswal to ride the bounce and softly dab the ball down to gully.
26.5: Zak Gibson bangs it in short on middle stump, forcing Yashasvi Jaiswal to sink low and let the ball sail through to the keeper.
26.6: Zak Gibson swings one into the left-hander, turned away to mid-wicket by Yashasvi Jaiswal as the umpires signal lunch on Day 1.
27.2: Jarrod McKay digs it in short, and an awkward bounce big on the bat forces Sai Sudharsan to mistime his pull straight to mid-on.
37.1: Zak Gibson strays down leg, and Yashasvi Jaiswal punishes the error by glancing it fine for a crisp boundary.
37.2: Zak Gibson drops it fuller and angles it across, leaving Yashasvi Jaiswal reaching with static feet and beating the outside edge.
37.3: Zak Gibson targets a full length close to off, prompting Yashasvi Jaiswal into a driveless push straight to mid-off.
37.4: Zak Gibson hurls it miles down the leg side, allowing Yashasvi Jaiswal to ignore it as Max Chu flings himself into a full-length glove save.
37.5: Zak Gibson digs it fractionally short, where an under-edged cut by Yashasvi Jaiswal threads the needle between second slip and gully to find the rope.
37.6: Zak Gibson invites the drive with a fuller offering outside off, drawing a booming stroke from Yashasvi Jaiswal that nearly kisses the edge on its way to Max Chu.
38.1: Cameron Paul pitches full around off, and Sai Sudharsan tucks his bat away behind the pad to let it pass safely through.
38.2: Cameron Paul induces an inside edge that scurries away into the deep square leg region, allowing Sai Sudharsan and his partner to scamper through for a single.
38.3: Cameron Paul fires one down the leg side, leaving Yashasvi Jaiswal stretching vainly in an attempt to help it on its way.
38.4: Cameron Paul keeps it full and around off, and Yashasvi Jaiswal smoothly angles his bat to squeeze it out toward point.
38.5: Cameron Paul spears it into the pads, and Yashasvi Jaiswal whips it through the leg side to effortlessly collect a brace.
38.6: Cameron Paul offers a full delivery outside off, and Yashasvi Jaiswal drives firmly but picks out the fielder at mid-off.
39.1: No run for Sai Sudharsan off Zak Gibson.
39.2: Zak Gibson drops a full delivery wide outside off, leaving Sai Sudharsan entirely unbothered as he watches it sail past.
39.3: Zak Gibson tests the channel outside off with a back of a length delivery, drawing a late, cautious withdrawal from Sai Sudharsan just as the ball zips past the edge.
39.4: Zak Gibson hits a tight length close to off, and Sai Sudharsan cushions it gently into the off side with exceptionally soft hands.
39.5: Zak Gibson serves up a good length delivery outside off, and Sai Sudharsan simply hoists his willow high to let it breeze through.
39.6: Zak Gibson fires in a low full toss outside off, forcing Sai Sudharsan to angle his bat face and desperately squeeze it away toward gully.
49.2: Randell angles one sharply back in from the crease, catching Padikkal stuck on the spot as an inside edge trickles away toward square leg.
49.3: Randell attacks from a back of a length, and Padikkal drops his weight directly behind the line to stonewall it.
49.4: Randell pushes full and invitingly around off, leaving Padikkal caught short of a full stride as the ball zips past the outside edge.
49.5: Randell drifts a delivery back of a length outside the tramlines, allowing Padikkal to stand tall and offer a comfortable shoulder of arms.
49.6: Padikkal marches aggressively down the track to smother the length, meeting it full-face to drive cleanly to mid-off.
50.1: Ferns extracts steep lift from a short of a length, watching it climb safely past off stump as Sudharsan wisely lets it sail through.
50.2: Ferns probes away from a back of a length just outside off, inviting no temptation as Sudharsan judges the width and shoulders arms.
50.3: Ferns maintains a disciplined length wide of off, where Sudharsan tucks his willow neatly behind the pad and watches it pass.
50.4: Ferns pushes full of a good length, drawing a forward stride from Sudharsan who hides his bat snugly behind the pad.
50.5: Ferns gets this one to jag away sharply outside off, prompting Sudharsan to instantly hoist his bat and let the keeper collect.
50.6: Ferns darts one onto the hip, and Sudharsan deftly works it backward of square leg to pinch a single that keeps him on strike.
51.1: Randell catches Sudharsan on the thigh pad after an enterprising shuffle down and across fails to connect with a tucked shot.
51.2: Randell digs it back of a length as Sai Sudharsan guards his off-stump and watches it climb past.
51.3: Randell drops it fractionally short, enticing a fierce pull from Sai Sudharsan that only dribbles tamely to mid-on.
51.4: Randell pushes fuller, and Sai Sudharsan tucks his bat safely behind the pad while letting it sail through.
51.5: Randell oversteps on a full delivery near off, inducing an outer-edge defence from Sai Sudharsan toward gully.
51.5: Randell delivers and Sai Sudharsan works it softly in front of mid-on with gentle hands, scampering across for a brisk single.
51.6: Randell targets outside off on a good length, leaving Devdutt Padikkal to shoulder arms as day one tea is called.
56.3: Zak Gibson darts one in short and down leg as Devdutt Padikkal flashes blindly at the flick and misses entirely.
56.4: Zak Gibson comes from round the wicket, forcing Devdutt Padikkal to watch a rising back-of-a-length delivery pass safely outside off.
56.5: Zak Gibson targets middle with a good length, and Devdutt Padikkal marches down to nudge it through mid-wicket for a comfortable two.
56.6: Zak Gibson bowls short, and though cramped, Devdutt Padikkal leans back to execute a superb late-cut past gully for four.
57.1: Randell fires a full ball angled into off, met solidly by Sai Sudharsan in a forward defensive stance toward cover.
57.2: Randell drops it short on middle, allowing Sai Sudharsan to step forward and tuck it away toward deep square leg for a single.
57.3: With Max Chu up to the stumps, Randell bowls a tight length on middle that Devdutt Padikkal defends from the back foot to mid-off.
57.4: Randell angles a length delivery into middle, and Devdutt Padikkal gets forward to glide it down to fine-leg for a single.
57.5: Randell bends his back for a rising short ball outside off, expertly left alone and safely collected by Max Chu.
57.6: Randell pitches full outside off, and Sai Sudharsan drives gorgeously with high elbows through the gap wide of cover and mid-off for four.
58.1: Zak Gibson offers width outside off, prompting a gorgeous cover-drive from Devdutt Padikkal that picks out the fielder directly.
58.2: Zak Gibson gets a back-of-a-length delivery to rear sharply and nip into off-stump, prompting Devdutt Padikkal to smoothly withdraw his bat.
58.3: Zak Gibson fires it from wide of the crease, angling in on a good length to almost square up Devdutt Padikkal before he defends it toward backward point.
58.4: Zak Gibson extracts terrifying extra bounce as a full delivery nicks past the outside edge of a totally opened-up Devdutt Padikkal.
58.5: Zak Gibson offers plenty of room on a length well outside off stump, allowing Devdutt Padikkal to watch it sail through to the keeper.
58.6: Zak Gibson digs it back of a length down leg, drawing an unsuccessful caught-behind appeal from the fielding side as Shaun Haig remains unmoved.
59.1: Cameron Paul swings a length delivery down the leg side, squeezing past the keeper's glove for a single bye.
59.2: Cameron Paul attacks the pads with another straighter length ball down leg, safely gathered by the keeper.
59.3: Cameron Paul drifts full down the leg side, clipped away securely as India A collects two runs towards fine leg.
67.1: Cameron Paul lands it full, sharp late inswing past Sai Sudharsan's inside edge as he flicks across the line.
67.2: Cameron Paul angles it back of a length outside off, leaving Sai Sudharsan to comfortably let it pass.
67.3: Cameron Paul pushes a full delivery on off that Sai Sudharsan defends, but the siren sounds for a front-foot overstep.
67.3: Cameron Paul offers width outside off, shaping away as Sai Sudharsan harmlessly waves his bat through.
67.4: Cameron Paul digs it in short of a length on middle, punched off the back foot by Sai Sudharsan wide of backward point for a single.
67.5: Cameron Paul delivers a short of length ball outside off, ignored completely by Dhruv Jurel.
67.6: Cameron Paul targets the body from a short length, catching Dhruv Jurel on the person as the pull shot misses.
68.1: Ferns drops it short of length and rising on off, handled expertly off the back foot by Sai Sudharsan right into the turf before gully.
68.2: Ferns bangs it short on the stumps, swivelled away by Sai Sudharsan off the back foot to deep backward square-leg for a run.
68.3: Ferns hits a back of a length outside off that nips back sharply, met solidly by Dhruv Jurel onto gully.
68.4: Ferns patrols the corridor of uncertainty outside off, watched intently by Dhruv Jurel as he shoulders arms.
68.5: Ferns produces a vicious jagged cutter from a rising length that cramps Dhruv Jurel on the back foot and thuds into his unprotected right arm.
68.6: Ferns drops it back of a length on off, and Dhruv Jurel stays back to dead-bat it straight toward backward point.
69.1: Cameron Paul fires a back of a length delivery outside off, which Sai Sudharsan steers off the back foot out to deep point for a single.
69.2: Cameron Paul floats a wide one full outside off, allowing Dhruv Jurel to stretch and angle the face past gully for four runs.
69.3: Cameron Paul targets the channel outside off, and Dhruv Jurel wisely offers no shot to the short-of-length delivery.
70.1: Dean Foxcroft floats one in on a length, and Sai Sudharsan strides forward to absorb the spin with a defensive prod.
70.2: Dean Foxcroft pulls his length back slightly outside off, allowing Sai Sudharsan to drop his weight onto the back foot and punch it firmly toward deepish mid-off for a single.
70.3: Dean Foxcroft zips a fuller delivery through the air, but Dhruv Jurel meets it squarely on the front foot with a dead-bat block.
70.4: Dean Foxcroft tosses it up invitingly, and Dhruv Jurel leans into the front foot to smother the ball safely.
70.5: Dean Foxcroft skids one through on a tight line near off stump, keeping low as Dhruv Jurel smartly drops his hands to defend from the crease.
70.6: Dean Foxcroft serves up a full delivery, and Dhruv Jurel softly guides it to deepish mid-on to scamper through and keep the strike.
71.1: Cameron Paul digs it in short outside off, tempting Dhruv Jurel into a fierce swivel-pull that ultimately whistles past empty air.
71.2: Cameron Paul targets the channel and gets one to nip away, leaving Dhruv Jurel to watch it sail through to the gloves.
71.3: Cameron Paul pitches it on a harmless length outside off, offering Dhruv Jurel an easy leave as it travels to the keeper.
71.4: Cameron Paul rattles the rib cage with a sharp delivery, forcing Dhruv Jurel onto his toes to tuck it away square on the leg side for a sharp single.
71.5: Cameron Paul drifts onto the pads, and Sai Sudharsan neatly clips it down toward fine leg to collect a comfortable run.
71.6: Cameron Paul lands it on a good length outside off, and Dhruv Jurel wisely offers no shot to conclude the over.
72.1: Dean Foxcroft floats this up on middle and Sai Sudharsan steers it smoothly toward mid-wicket.
72.2: Dean Foxcroft tosses it around off and Sai Sudharsan drives it straight back off the inner half.
72.3: Dean Foxcroft fires it onto the leg stump and Sai Sudharsan glances it squarely into the leg side.
72.4: Dean Foxcroft drops it full near off and Sai Sudharsan strides forward to dead-bat it toward cover.
72.5: Dean Foxcroft loops up a very full delivery on the stumps which Sai Sudharsan digs out toward cover.
72.6: Dean Foxcroft completes a tidy maiden over as Sai Sudharsan jams the full ball straight back on the bounce.
82.3: Randell comes round the wicket, nearly squaring up Sai Sudharsan as the ball holds its line to catch the shoulder of the bat and dribble toward gully.
82.4: Randell tests him again as Sai Sudharsan shifts outside the off stump and dabs the ball softly to his left.
82.5: Randell offers a full delivery shaping away to tempt a drive, but the left-handed Sai Sudharsan watches it pass untouched.
82.6: Randell sends down a harmless full-length ball outside the off stump, which Sai Sudharsan comfortably leaves alone.
83.1: Ferns gets a hint of late movement as Dhruv Jurel blocks it firmly off the front foot.
83.2: Ferns targets the stumps, and Dhruv Jurel responds with another rock-solid defensive block.
83.3: Ferns bowls it in, and Dhruv Jurel works the delivery neatly into the leg side.
83.4: Ferns pitches short of a good length, and Dhruv Jurel guides his defense toward the point region.
83.5: Ferns generates sharp inward movement into the pads, catching Jurel as he misses his whip, though the ball was drifting down leg.
83.6: Ferns extracts extravagant inward movement down leg as Jurel misses the clip and the wicketkeeper dives smartly to his left to get a hand on it.
84.1: Randell tests Sai Sudharsan, who stays watchful behind the line with a solid defensive block straight back.
84.2: Randell drifts down leg past Sai Sudharsan, allowing the keeper to dive to his right and pouch it cleanly.
84.3: Randell hits a heavy length, extracting sharp, unexpected bounce that catches Sai Sudharsan uncomfortably high near the waist on the angle.
84.4: Randell drifts a wide full delivery across the left-hander, inviting Sai Sudharsan to comfortably watch it sail through.
84.5: Randell angles another length delivery into the channel, prompting Sai Sudharsan to neatly shield his stumps and offer no stroke.
84.6: Randell attacks from just back of a good length, allowing Sai Sudharsan to softly drop it away to his left and successfully close out a maiden over.
85.1: Ferns drifts onto the pads, and Dhruv Jurel whips it powerfully into the gap at deep mid-wicket to comfortably scamper back for a scampering third.
85.2: Ferns errs down the leg side, leaving Sai Sudharsan grasping in vain as he looks to tickle it fine.
85.3: Ferns extracts extravagant movement away from a length outside off, completely ignored by Sai Sudharsan.
85.4: Ferns serves up a full toss outside off, allowing B Sai Sudharsan to punch his flick straight to the fielder at mid-on.
85.5: Ferns pitches full in the channel outside off, and Sai Sudharsan steps across to watch it harmlessly through.
92.1: Cameron Paul draws the false stroke as Dhruv Jurel miscues a pull straight to Jarrod McKay at fine leg, ending a valiant seventy-one.
92.2: Cameron Paul attacks the channel outside off, and Ravindra Jadeja watches it sail harmlessly through to the keeper.
92.3: Cameron Paul offers width once more, and Ravindra Jadeja easily judges the trajectory to leave it alone.
92.4: Cameron Paul strays into the pads, allowing Ravindra Jadeja to whip it aggressively through mid-wicket for a brisk three runs.
92.5: Cameron Paul digs it in short and angling away, forcing Tilak Varma to sharply withdraw his bat at the very last moment.
92.6: Cameron Paul shifts to a fuller length outside off, prompting an authoritative shoulder of arms from Tilak Varma.
93.1: Zak Gibson lands a full delivery that Ravindra Jadeja solidly pushes straight back down the pitch to the bowler.
93.2: Zak Gibson tests the left-hander with a rising delivery, but Ravindra Jadeja gets on top of it cleanly to defend into the off side.
93.3: Zak Gibson drifts onto the pads, deflecting away off the body with no shot offered as the umpire signals no runs scored.
93.4: Zak Gibson angles a fullish delivery across the tramlines, and Ravindra Jadeja lets it pass by without a stroke.
93.5: Zak Gibson probes the channel outside off stump, and Ravindra Jadeja watches it sail past untouched into the gloves.
93.6: Zak Gibson drops it near the-batter, and Ravindra Jadeja smartly turns it toward backward square leg to retain the strike.
94.1: Tim Robinson drops it full and wide of off stump, inviting Ravindra Jadeja into a stroke that the left-hander wisely declines.
94.2: Tim Robinson pulls his length back on a similar channel outside off, and Ravindra Jadeja watches it comfortably sail past.
94.3: Tim Robinson offers width and a shorter length, allowing Ravindra Jadeja to reach out and drill it along the turf to sweeper cover for a single.
94.4: Tim Robinson slants a full delivery across the outside edge, but Tilak Varma reads the line impeccably and lets it breeze through to the keeper.
94.5: Tim Robinson delivers to Tilak Varma, who works the ball swiftly into the short mid-wicket region to hustle through for a single.
94.6: No-ball from Tim Robinson to Ravindra Jadeja, 2 runs in all.
98.1: Matthew Boyle drops it on a length, allowing Ravindra Jadeja to tap it towards sweeper cover for a brisk single.
98.2: Matthew Boyle tosses this one up, and Tilak Varma simply eases it down to mid-on.
98.3: Matthew Boyle tests Ravindra Jadeja, who strides forward to dead-bat the delivery.
98.4: Matthew Boyle zips one well outside the off stump, safely ignored by Ravindra Jadeja.
98.5: Matthew Boyle offers flight on middle, whipped away by Ravindra Jadeja into the deep mid-wicket pocket for one.
98.6: Matthew Boyle gets a hint of turn down the leg side as Tilak Varma fails to connect with his glance.
99.1: Dean Foxcroft loops it up outside off, and the batsman watches it sail past.
99.2: Dean Foxcroft floats one wide of off, where the left-hander drops low to sweep it firmly to deep square leg.
99.3: Dean Foxcroft extracts subtle drift and slow turn, prompting Tilak Varma to softly dab it toward point.
99.4: Dean Foxcroft darts it onto middle and leg, comfortably nudged by Tilak Varma out to long-on for a run.
99.5: Dean Foxcroft pitches it on off, met by a forward prod from Ravindra Jadeja straight back to the bowler.
99.6: Dean Foxcroft induces another sweep from far outside off, dragged away toward deep square leg for a single.
100.1: Matthew Boyle drops it short and angles it across, allowing Ravindra Jadeja to rock back and sweep it out to deep cover for a single.
100.2: Matthew Boyle keeps it short around off stump, and Tilak Varma plays a back-foot punch straight to the cover fielder.
100.3: Matthew Boyle extracts sharp turn and good bounce as the ball beats Tilak Varma's attempted leg-side clip and flashes past the stumps.
100.4: Matthew Boyle tosses it up with vicious spin, trapping Tilak Varma on the front-foot pad safely outside the line of off stump.
100.5: Matthew Boyle pushes through a quicker delivery, giving Tilak Varma no trouble on the front-foot defensive prod.
100.6: Matthew Boyle offers width and a shorter length, inviting Tilak Varma to carve two runs behind point as the umpires signal lunch on Day 2.
113.1: Dean Foxcroft tosses it up just outside off, and Washington Sundar strides forward to comfortably leave it alone.
113.2: Foxcroft drops it a fraction short outside off, prompting Sundar to back away and punch off the back foot straight to cover.
113.3: Foxcroft fires in a flatter delivery drifting into the left-hander, which Sundar clips off the back foot past mid-wicket for a single.
113.4: Dean Foxcroft floats this one up and drifts it away from the left-handed Tilak Varma, who fails to get fully forward in defence and has his outside edge thoroughly beaten by the turn.
113.5: Foxcroft floats it up on off stump, and Tilak drops back to play a defensive push.
113.6: Foxcroft tosses it up nicely on middle and leg, allowing Tilak to nudge it behind square on the on-side for a single.
114.1: Zak Gibson serves up a long half-volley, and Tilak leans forward to cream a gorgeous drive through extra-cover to the boundary.
114.2: Gibson lands it on a good length angling into the left-hander, and Tilak leans across to dead-bat it onto the on-side.
114.3: Gibson pitches it fuller and angles it into Tilak, who flicks across the line as the ball lobs off the pad back to the bowler for an unsuccessful appeal.
114.4: Gibson delivers a good-length ball angling in, and Tilak shuffles across to turn an inside edge onto the on-side.
114.5: Gibson bangs it short and well down the leg side, leaving Tilak an easy decision to watch it pass.
114.6: Gibson digs in another bouncer just outside off, forcing Tilak to duck underneath and let it sail through.
115.1: Dean Foxcroft gives it air on off stump, inviting Washington Sundar forward to smother the spin securely.
115.2: Dean Foxcroft floats one up on off, prompting Washington Sundar to retreat swiftly and deadbat the ball into the pitch.
115.3: Dean Foxcroft drops it fractionally short outside off, allowing Washington Sundar to work it off the back foot past square leg for a single.
115.4: Dean Foxcroft tosses it up on middle and leg, and Tilak Varma stays back to turn it securely into the on-side.
115.5: Dean Foxcroft fires a flatter delivery just outside off, punched sharply off the back foot before Dale Phillips dives to his right to save the boundary.
115.6: Dean Foxcroft slows his pace outside off, meeting a half-forward Tilak Varma who simply pushes it straight back down the pitch.
125.2: Dean Foxcroft tosses it up just outside off, and Washington Sundar drives it straight back to the bowler.
125.3: Foxcroft serves another flighted delivery outside off, which Washington Sundar punches off the back foot to cover.
125.4: Foxcroft lands this one on middle and off, prompting a half-stride forward as Washington Sundar defends.
125.5: Foxcroft loops it up just outside off, and Washington Sundar strokes the back-foot punch out to long-off for a single.
125.6: Foxcroft drifts one onto the pads, played back with soft hands and tucked behind square on the on-side for a single.
126.1: Matthew Boyle tosses it up just outside off, met by a solid stride forward as Tilak Varma blocks.
126.2: Boyle flights this one on off stump, and Tilak Varma gets right behind it in defense.
